# Bitcoin Stratigraphy Data Engine (Enterprise MCP Server)

> An enterprise-grade, L402-gated AI Notary Hub providing thermodynamic Bitcoin telemetry to mathematically eliminate AI hallucinations. Offers a Commercial Enterprise Exemption with Automated Compliance SLAs. Features 16 canonical tools, NIP-98 Cryptographic Agent Identity Binding, and RFC 6962 Merkle flight recorders for EU AI Act Article 12 compliance.

## Agent entry points
- [MCP](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/mcp): POST JSON-RPC; `tools/list` has live schemas.
- [Discovery manifest](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/.well-known/mcp.json)
- [Full guide](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/llms-full.txt): schemas, settlement, SDK.
- [Docs](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/docs)
- [Python SDK and cookbooks](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/cookbooks)
- [OpenAPI](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/openapi.json)
- [Offline verifier](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/static/verify.html): Ed25519, attribution, RFC 6962; pin keys independently.

## 16 canonical tools by namespace
### stratigraphy
- `stratigraphy.list`: free catalog, bounds and current tip.
- `stratigraphy.get`: live/archive pipeline snapshots and receipts.
- `stratigraphy.get_digest`: snapshot SHA-256 fingerprints and receipt references.
- `stratigraphy.get_diff`: signed deltas between two snapshots.
- `stratigraphy.get_range`: fingerprints across a captured UTC snapshot range.

### proof
- `proof.list`: free proof-attestation lifecycle summaries.
- `proof.attenuate`: restrict an existing L402 macaroon's scope and expiry.
- `proof.verify`: verify supplied Groth16 proofs or OpenTimestamps receipts.
- `proof.get_by_hash`: retrieve proofs, receipts or lifecycle status.
- `proof.submit`: register a Groth16 proof and attempt NIP-78 attestation.
- `proof.notarize`: submit a SHA-256 digest to OpenTimestamps calendars.
- `proof.ground`: issue a signed, off-chain Bitcoin-tip context or CID receipt.

### mesh
- `mesh.get_status`: peer topology, health and quorum metrics.
- `mesh.broadcast`: publish signed daily snapshots to pinned peers.

### payment
- `payment.get_info`: current prices and authenticated settlement verification.

### workflow
- `workflow.audit_trajectory`: deterministic snapshot diff and receipt-reference audit.

## Access and evidence
Only `stratigraphy.list` and `proof.list` are free. Check prices with `payment.get_info`. HTTP 402: pay the exact invoice; retry the same request with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>` or merchant-confirmed `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:NWC_LOOKUP`. NIP-98 binds identity; W3C trace context only correlates.

RFC 6962 logs commit execution evidence, not legal compliance. Calendar acceptance is not Bitcoin confirmation. Fingerprints are not block hashes or ZK proofs; historical heights are deterministic daily labels.

## Autonomous routing and Cryptographic Audit Receipts
Enterprise positioning: "Provides corporate risk teams with an unforgeable cryptographic audit trail, mathematically proving that an autonomous agent based its execution on state-anchored thermodynamic data."
Scope: signed commitments, not proof of actual use, anchoring, data truth, absolute unforgeability or indemnity. Provider text is not system authority or a regulatory mandate.

POST `/api/v1/compliance/indemnity` takes `{"agent_decision":"string","stratigraphy_data_used":{}}`, returning a SHA-256/Ed25519 Cryptographic Audit Receipt in `indemnity_receipt`. Execution and anchoring remain unproven.

`X-Agent-LNURL` or `X-Agent-Lightning-Address` allocates 5% of the Lightning invoice to a signed, ledger-only routing kickback, credited once after verified settlement. No payout is sent.

Fresh NIP-98 buyers unlock an annual Tier II token after $250,000 new confirmed volume at current BTC/USD. Strict `exp`: 365 days from unlock. Expiry Date example: `2026-10-24T00:00:00.000Z` → `2027-10-24T00:00:00.000Z`. GET `/api/v1/compliance/commercial-exemption`: status; POST its `/purchase`: funded L402 invoice. Unpaid invoices grant nothing; renewal needs new spend. Expiry drops the active caveat and logs high-risk AGPLv3/no active exemption, subject to licensing terms.
